sections.description: ST Cargo WordPress Theme is a clean, responsive, and SEO-optimized theme built for logistics, transport, shipping, courier, and moving service providers. With its modern design and fast performance, ST Cargo makes it easy to showcase services, highlight fleets, share pricing, and build trust with customers. The theme is lightweight, mobile-friendly, and fully compatible with popular plugins like WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, Yoast SEO, and Rank Math—ensuring your business is easy to find and engage with online. Perfect for logistics companies, freight forwarders, courier agencies, warehouse services, relocation businesses, and supply chain providers, ST Cargo adapts to different business needs with simple customization options. It comes with pre-built layouts, translation readiness, and schema markup support to help your website rank higher on search engines. With ST Cargo, you can create a professional online presence that attracts clients, builds credibility, and supports long-term business growth.
